name: Easy Aerobic Ride
focus: Re-establish movement habit, aerobic stimulus without stress

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85-90 rpm, HR below 145 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, 88-92 rpm, HR 146-158 bpm. If HR runs high due to fatigue, back off to low end of power window.
Z1 soft pedal, HR below 130 bpm before stopping

name: Easy Aerobic Ride — Cadence Focus
focus: Aerobic efficiency and neuromuscular cadence work at low intensity

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85 rpm, HR settling below 145 bpm
Z2 cadence block — alternate each rep: 85 rpm / 95-100 rpm / 80 rpm / 90 rpm. HR 146-160 bpm. Reduce power if HR exceeds 165 bpm.
Z1 soft spin, breathe down, HR below 130 bpm

name: Bodyweight & Band Strength — Shoulder Safe
focus: Reactivate lower body and core, protect shoulder, build movement quality
notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg, 8x TRX split squat each leg, 15x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug each side, 30s plank. Rest 60-75s between exercises, 90s between rounds. Avoid any shoulder loading — substitute dead bug for any pressing or pulling. Stop thoracic stretch if shoulder pinches.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral x10 each, hip circles x10 each direction, bodyweight squat x10 slow, glute bridge x10
2 rounds: goblet squat 16kg x10, RDL 16kg x10, TRX split squat x8 each leg, banded glute bridge x15, dead bug x8 each side, plank 30s. Rest 60-75s between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Hip flexor stretch 30s each side, lying hamstring stretch 30s each side, child's pose 30s, gentle thoracic rotation — skip if shoulder protests
